quotes.text: It only needs to be called when we're changing folder, not every time we change the view, which is how we get into trouble with quick filtering.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Use numMsgsInView for synthetic message totals because collapsed threads reduce rowCount without reducing messages. Update header identity on actual folder/synthetic selection; update message count after load/filter changes and removal. Decrement based on actual affected message headers. The2024 review replaced timeout/multiple-trigger attempts with lifecycle ownership, and reported a remaining filtered synthetic deletion edge. Do not reuse onCreatedView as a folder-change signal or claim every count edge is fixed.
title: Synthetic message totals differ from displayed row counts
